variables.input:
timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime), by: { cluster_name }
| fields cluster_name

timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }), by: { service }
| fields service

timeseries avg(aerospike_namespace_objects, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }), by: { ns }
| fields ns

timeseries avg(aerospike_sets_data_used_bytes, filter: { in(ns, array($namespace)) and cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }), by: { `set` }
| fields `set`

0.content: **Set Dashboard**: Objects, data used and indexes per set: which sets grow. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

2.content:
### Aerospike Version

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (count_values()). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count_values by (build) ("build_numbers", (aerospike_node_up{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}) )
```

3.content:
### Alerts

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (Prometheus alert state (ALERTS) -- alerts are not in Dynatrace). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count by (severity) (ALERTS{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace|$^", severity=~"warn|critical|info|error", set=~"$set",}) 
```

8.content:
### % Set Quota Used (topk)

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (arithmetic between series that are already summarized, sorted or counted). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
topk( $set_quota_topk,sort_desc((
  (aerospike_sets_memory_data_bytes{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^", set=~"$set",}+aerospike_sets_device_data_bytes{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^", set=~"$set",})
  /(aerospike_sets_stop_writes_size{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^", set=~"$set",}!=0) )*100))
topk( $set_quota_topk, sort_desc((
  (aerospike_sets_data_used_bytes{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^", set=~"$set",})
  /(aerospike_sets_stop_writes_size{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^", set=~"$set",}!=0) )*100) )
```
